meta.note: Educational knowledge base. Likelihoods derived from a labeled dataset with limited symptom variation per disease; not a clinically validated model. Not a medical device.

descriptions.fungal_infection: Fungal infection is a common skin condition caused by fungi.
descriptions.allergy: Allergy is an immune system reaction to a substance in the environment.
descriptions.gerd: GERD (Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease) is a digestive disorder that affects the lower esophageal sphincter.
descriptions.chronic_cholestasis: Chronic cholestasis is a condition where bile flow from the liver is reduced for a prolonged period.
descriptions.drug_reaction: Drug Reaction occurs when the body reacts adversely to a medication.
descriptions.peptic_ulcer_disease: Peptic ulcer disease involves sores that develop on the inner lining of the stomach and small intestine.
descriptions.aids: AIDS (Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome) is a disease caused by HIV that weakens the immune system.
descriptions.diabetes: Diabetes is a chronic condition that affects how the body processes blood sugar.
descriptions.gastroenteritis: Gastroenteritis is an inflammation of the stomach and intestines, typically caused by a virus or bacteria.
descriptions.bronchial_asthma: Bronchial Asthma is a respiratory condition characterized by inflammation of the airways.
descriptions.hypertension: Hypertension, or high blood pressure, is a common cardiovascular condition.
descriptions.migraine: Migraine is a type of headache that often involves severe pain and sensitivity to light and sound.
descriptions.cervical_spondylosis: Cervical spondylosis is a degenerative condition of the cervical spine.
descriptions.paralysis_brain_hemorrhage: Paralysis (brain hemorrhage) refers to the loss of muscle function due to bleeding in the brain.
descriptions.jaundice: Jaundice is a yellow discoloration of the skin and eyes, often indicating liver problems.
descriptions.malaria: Malaria is a mosquito-borne infectious disease affecting humans and other animals.
descriptions.chicken_pox: Chicken pox is a highly contagious viral infection causing an itchy rash.
descriptions.dengue: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection causing flu-like symptoms.
descriptions.typhoid: Typhoid is a bacterial infection that can lead to a high fever and gastrointestinal symptoms.
descriptions.hepatitis_a: hepatitis A is a viral liver disease.
descriptions.hepatitis_b: Hepatitis B is a viral infection that attacks the liver.
descriptions.hepatitis_c: Hepatitis C is a viral infection that causes liver inflammation.
descriptions.hepatitis_d: Hepatitis D is a serious liver disease caused by the hepatitis D virus.
descriptions.hepatitis_e: Hepatitis E is a viral infection that causes liver inflammation.
descriptions.alcoholic_hepatitis: Alcoholic hepatitis is inflammation of the liver due to alcohol consumption.
descriptions.tuberculosis: Tuberculosis is a bacterial infection that primarily affects the lungs.
descriptions.common_cold: Common Cold is a viral infection of the upper respiratory tract.
descriptions.pneumonia: Pneumonia is an inflammatory condition affecting the air sacs in the lungs.
descriptions.dimorphic_hemmorhoids_piles: Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles) is a condition characterized by swollen blood vessels in the rectum.
descriptions.heart_attack: Heart attack is a sudden and severe reduction in blood flow to the heart muscle.
descriptions.varicose_veins: Varicose veins are enlarged, twisted veins that usually appear on the legs.
descriptions.hypothyroidism: Hypothyroidism is a condition where the thyroid gland doesn't produce enough thyroid hormone.
descriptions.hyperthyroidism: Hyperthyroidism is a condition where the thyroid gland produces too much thyroid hormone.
descriptions.hypoglycemia: Hypoglycemia is a condition characterized by abnormally low blood sugar levels.
descriptions.osteoarthristis: Osteoarthristis is a degenerative joint disease that affects the cartilage in joints.
descriptions.arthritis: Arthritis is inflammation of one or more joints, causing pain and stiffness.
descriptions.vertigo_paroymsal_positional_vertigo: (Vertigo) Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo is a type of dizziness caused by specific head movements.
descriptions.acne: Acne is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become clogged with oil and dead skin cells.
descriptions.urinary_tract_infection: Urinary tract infection is an infection in any part of the urinary system.
descriptions.psoriasis: Psoriasis is a chronic skin condition characterized by red, itchy, and scaly patches.
descriptions.impetigo: Impetigo is a highly contagious skin infection causing red sores that can break open.

psoriasis: wash hands with warm soapy water
impetigo: soak affected area in warm water
remove scabs with wet compressed cloth
cervical_spondylosis: use heating pad or cold pack
varicose_veins: lie down flat and raise the leg high
fungal_infection: use detol or neem in bathing water
jaundice: eat fruits and high fiberous food
gastroenteritis: stop eating solid food for while
try taking small sips of water
